sourceRefs.locator: Inv. 56.460, Description and Matières et techniques: inscription, costume, loss on 5 November 1831, wax impression in Ms. 609 fol. 63v, its rediscovery in 1857 and production of the gilt electrotype.

Namur copy R6A.0608. Printed p. 96, digitised page 119: Annuli aurei, middle row; p. 322, digitised page 348: insects with and without eyes, arranged in alternating orientations. Title and imprint: Antwerp, 1655.

summary.de: Der goldene Ring trägt in einem Porträtfeld Name und Königstitel. Nach dem Diebstahl von 1831 blieben Abdrücke und ältere Abbildungen.
summary.en: The gold ring bore a portrait, a name and a royal title. Impressions and earlier illustrations survived the theft in 1831.
